basics.name: Rutuja Gavhane
basics.label: Visual Storyteller & Graphic Designer | UI/UX & Web Design
basics.summary: I have fallen in love with the world of creativity, where ideas turn into purposeful and meaningful designs. What started as a childhood interest has grown into a focused journey in visual and UI/UX design. I am always eager to learn and explore new tools and techniques that enhance my creative thinking and execution. I enjoy working with form, scale, contrast, color, typography, visual hierarchy, and space to craft balanced and engaging designs. I have a strong understanding of color schemes, layouts, content presentation, and imagery selection, enabling me to create visuals that capture attention, communicate effectively, and leave a lasting impression.

bullets: Designed engaging social media creatives including reels, story posts, carousel designs, static posts, and Facebook cover creatives.
Created visual content based on client requirements while maintaining brand consistency and design quality.
Collaborated with senior designers and executed assigned tasks with attention to detail and accuracy.
Managed multiple design requests simultaneously and consistently met tight deadlines.
Quickly adapted designs based on feedback to meet deadlines.
Executed design tasks as per senior guidance and project requirements.
Created presets and image overlays using Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom.
Designed visual content using Canva while maintaining consistency and quality.
Delivered assigned work within timelines with a strong focus on accuracy.
Incorporated feedback effectively to refine and improve designs.
